title: 第六十二章 灰绅士的行动谈谈一些关于本书的心里话
content_zh:
“本来是有的……但从刚才的乐园公告来看，很快烈阳星就会有大动作，古龙阵营和太阳国度的高层，必然会有应对策略，所以现在暂时无法确定。”
“那这样，我在烈阳之地的边境，还藏了一票黑暗神教教众和畸变体，你可以随时调用，这处镜面空间也是。”
【提示：你的仆从?普帕斯已累积击杀亚龙人*189，亚龙*27。】
【提示：你获得了7.89%世界之源，当前世界之源178.42%。】
……
王长乐闻言点了点头，他自然明白沐阳的意思，破浪者?格罗姆之所以常年在混乱之海厮混，
原本就是古龙阵营，用来牵制太阳国度和太阳阵营，防止被大范围侵入古龙阵营的战略势力。
如今太阳神教实力大损，古龙阵营间隔太远，未必能在第一时间进行反攻，但太阳国度绝不会放弃这次机会。
古龙阵营若全面反攻，太阳神教和太阳国度在战时，绝对是互相守望的盟友，可一旦有一方，陷入绝对劣势。
那背后下刀时，也绝不会手软。
作为太阳国度的外交官，同时也是太阳神教覆灭者之一的沐阳，自然也就成了太阳国度?全面围剿的执行者了。
“我让欧珀分身跟着你，之后沐阳，你这边有初步计划了，随时参战，不过最近两天，我需要调整，如何？”
“好，那就这么说定了，你这……的确是要好好休养休养了。”
沐阳望着从空间涟漪中，钻出来的镜面分身，又看了看因『神灵源血』燃烧，面色惨白的王长乐。
起身就欲向着不远处的镜面而去，所罗门在向着王长乐点头示意后，也选择紧随其后。
下一秒，渊医的声音却适时响起。
“嘿，我说你们先等等，源初，这氏族战争你也不参加了么，你现在都已经快掉出前十了。”
“这样么，按照当前的世界格局，太阳神教即将面临势力级的洗牌……”
王长乐闻言，打开『氏族战争排行榜』看了眼，发现自己仍排在第七名后，当即身体放松，彻底躺了下来。
如今的排名，对他而言已经很够用了，王长乐参与『氏族战争』的初始目的，就是为了古龙阵营声望。

以确保自己能在『氏族战争』结束后，通过获得古龙阵营的支持，从而构建新势力，完成虚空声望任务。
现如今，普帕斯位居排行榜第四名，王长乐在古龙阵营的声望，也已经达到『龙心级』，自然没必要冲杀了。
即便他真的能登顶首位，王长乐也不可能将声望提升到『霜翼级』，何况『氏族战争』本是为了清洗，混乱之海上的亚龙族势力。
以巩固四大阵营自身的稳固，可现在却本末倒置，太阳神教顶尖战力锐减，别说是古龙阵营和太阳国度，会借此有所动作。
『渊巢』恐怕也不会甘于寂寞，若再算上各大亚龙部族，真正的势力级大清洗，恐怕就要要来了。
“这所谓的氏族战争，持续不了几天了，你要是想趁机登顶洗白，可以去找牧场主，他现在在太阳神教的实际地位，说不定比那位太阳督军还高。”
“洗白什么的，我没什么兴趣，不过既然源初你也想暂避锋芒，那不如帮我把这个公证了，和我一起去探索灭法遗迹吧。”
渊医话音未落，手中就出现了一枚有着明显炼金痕迹的断刃残片，上面隐隐有，类似青钢影的魂能波动溢出。
断刃残片刚出现，所罗门和沐阳就齐刷刷停住了脚步，目光向后偏转。
世界级任务，没谁愿意错过。
“当然，沐阳和所罗门两位，如果想一起探索，我也欢迎，遗迹的入口我已经找到了。”
“现在，没有时间。”
“我觉得源初的建议，你可以考虑下，以现在这个状况，就算世界级任务公证了，短时间也不会有时间处理，不过，世界级任务记得共享。”
所罗门的回答很快，但一次性吐出六个字，也足可见这位黑暗法爷，对这件事的看重程度了。
这一场大战，如果说受伤最重，那定然非王长乐莫属，可如果说战力损失最严重，那就只有所罗门了。
这其实和众人的战力体系有关，在场其他人的战力，基本都是由技法主职业体系构成。
只要身体伤势恢复，最多也就损伤装备的耐久度，不至于造成战力减退。
content_en:
"Originally there is... but judging from the announcement of the park just now, there will be big moves in Lieyang Star soon. The senior officials of the Gulong camp and the Kingdom of the Sun will definitely have a response strategy, so it is not yet certain for the time being."
"In that case, I have hidden a group of Dark God Cult members and aberrations at the border of the Land of the Burning Sun. You can call them at any time, and this mirror space is the same."
[Tip: Your servant Pupas has killed 189 Argonians and 27 Argonians. 】
[Tip: You have obtained 7.89% of the source of the world, and the current source of the world is 178.42%. 】
…
Wang Changle nodded when he heard this. He naturally understood what Mu Yang meant. The reason why Grom, the Breaker of Waves, hangs out in the Sea of Chaos all the year round is,
It was originally the ancient dragon camp, used to contain the Kingdom of the Sun and the sun camp, and prevent the strategic forces from being invaded by the ancient dragon camp on a large scale.
Now that the strength of the Sun God Sect has been greatly damaged, and the ancient dragon camps are too far apart, they may not be able to counterattack immediately, but the Kingdom of the Sun will never give up this opportunity.
If the ancient dragon camp makes a full-scale counterattack, the Sun God Sect and the Sun Kingdom will definitely be allies watching each other during the war, but once one of them is involved, they will be at an absolute disadvantage.
He will never be soft when he is stabbed in the back.
As a diplomat of the Sun Kingdom and one of the destroyers of the Sun God Cult, Mu Yang naturally became the executor of the Sun Kingdom's comprehensive encirclement and suppression.
"I asked Opal's clone to follow you. After that, Mu Yang, you have a preliminary plan and can join the battle at any time. But in the past two days, I need to make adjustments. How about it?"
"Okay, then it's settled, you... really need to take a good rest."
Mu Yang looked at the mirror clone that emerged from the ripples in space, and then looked at Wang Changle, whose face was pale due to the burning of "spiritual blood".
He stood up and headed towards the mirror not far away. After nodding to Wang Changle, Solomon also chose to follow closely.
The next second, Doctor Yuan's voice sounded at the right time.
"Hey, I told you to wait a moment, Yuanchu, aren't you going to participate in this clan war anymore? You are almost out of the top ten now."
"So, according to the current world structure, the Sun God Cult is about to face a reshuffle of power levels..."
After Wang Changle heard this, he opened the "Clan War Ranking" and took a look. After finding that he was still ranked seventh, he immediately relaxed his body and lay down completely.
The current ranking is enough for him. Wang Changle's original purpose of participating in the "Clan War" was to gain the reputation of the Gulong camp.
To ensure that after the "Clan War" ends, he can gain support from the ancient dragon camp to build a new force and complete the void reputation mission.
Nowadays, Pupas ranks fourth in the rankings, and Wang Changle's reputation in the ancient dragon camp has reached the "Dragon Heart Level", so there is no need to rush to kill him.
Even if he could really reach the top spot, Wang Changle would not be able to raise his reputation to the "Frost Wing Level", not to mention that the "Clan War" was originally intended to cleanse the Yalong clan forces on the Sea of ​​Chaos.
In order to consolidate the stability of the four major camps themselves, but now the cart is put before the horse, the top combat power of the Sun God Religion has been sharply reduced, not to mention the ancient dragon camp and the Kingdom of the Sun, who will take advantage of this to take action.
"Abyss Nest" may not be willing to be lonely. If the major sub-dragon tribes are also included, a real power-level purge may be coming.
"This so-called clan war will not last for a few days. If you want to take the opportunity to climb to the top to clear your name, you can go to the rancher. His actual status in the Sun God Cult may be higher than that of the Sun Warlord."
"I'm not interested in clearing my name or anything like that, but since you also want to avoid the spotlight temporarily at Yuanchu, why not help me get this notarized and explore the ruins of the extinguishing method with me."
Before Doctor Yuan finished speaking, a broken blade fragment with obvious traces of alchemy appeared in his hand. There was faintly visible soul energy fluctuations similar to those of the Qinggang Shadow on it.out.
As soon as the broken blade fragments appeared, Solomon and Mu Yang both stopped and turned their eyes back.
A world-class mission that no one wants to miss.
"Of course, Mu Yang and Solomon, if you want to explore together, I welcome you. I have found the entrance to the ruins."
"Now, there's no time."
"I think you can consider Yuanchu's suggestion. With the current situation, even if the world-class mission is notarized, there won't be time to process it in a short time. However, remember to share the world-class mission."
Solomon's answer was quick, but the fact that he uttered six words at once was enough to show how seriously the dark master took this matter.
In this battle, if the one who suffered the most serious injuries was definitely Wang Changle, but if the one who suffered the most serious losses in combat power was Solomon.
This is actually related to everyone's combat power system. The combat power of other people present is basically composed of the skill-based professional system.
As long as the body recovers from injuries, at most it will damage the durability of the equipment and will not cause a reduction in combat effectiveness.
